heading: MEET MOE DIMANCHE
text: Florida grown and a first-generation American, Moe Dimanche, born Moliere Dimanche, grew up under financial hardship in a single-parent home in Orlando, Florida. Moe and his brothers found joy, even during the hard times. His family briefly sought refuge at the Orlando Union Rescue Mission when Moe was just 7 years old while his mother went to Avanti to earn her cosmetology license, and escape poverty with her sons. She went on to become an instructor at Avanti and later opened her own salon in Jacksonville, instilling the principles of perseverance into her sons. A trip to Disney while the family was homeless was his mother’s way of hiding the effects of poverty from her sons.

heading: MEET MOE DIMANCHE
text: The pictures below are held by Moe’s father, who had been deported to Haiti in 1988.

heading: MEET MOE DIMANCHE
text: Moe is a product of Pine Hills. He attended Meadowbrook Middle School and Evans Ninth Grade Center briefly, before going on to attend West Orange High School. As a teen he held jobs at Winn-Dixie, Burger King, and Target before he found work with community pillar, Pops Garcia, at the family-owned Garcia’s Flooring & Remodeling. In 2005, Moe helped rebuild the entire assisted living facility, Antioch Manor, on Mercy Drive alongside the Garcia crew.

heading: EMPOWERING THE PEOPLE
text: Municipal incorporation of unincorporated county land is imperative to ensure public safety and full service to our communities. Moe led the push to incorporate Pine Hills into a municipality, and seeks the same for the entire western Orange County, and all unincorporated lands across the State of Florida, where 911 is deficient , infrastructure is poor, and crime is rampant.

heading: EMPOWERING THE PEOPLE
text: The key to public happiness is giving the members of the communities in these areas more control over their own well-being, their own tax dollars, and their own public works when counties underserve and ignore constituents in unincorporated areas.

heading: CLOSING ALLIGATOR ALCATRAZ
text: After Ron DeSantis and his attorney general introduced the plan for Alligator Alcatraz, the federal government tweeted out an image of alligators wearing ICE hats. This horrifying imagery is chilling, and promotes the idea that Floridians support the idea of feeding migrants to alligators.

heading: CLOSING ALLIGATOR ALCATRAZ
text: While our laws will be followed, we will not re-enact Jim Crow. During the Jim Crow era, Black babies were often fed to alligators under the racist name “ licorice drops “. This cruel practice has been extensively documented by the Jim Crow Museum , and with DeSantis and James Uthmeier bringing that back to make migrants the new licorice drops , this nation has already been set back more than 100 years. On Day 1 , Moe will permanently close Alligator Alcatraz.

heading: ABOLISHING HOAs and PROPERTY TAXES ON HOMESTEADS
text: HOAs are unconstitutional, and property taxes on Floridians’ homesteads infringes on ownership rights. While property taxes are an important way to fund our schools and public works, the state can fund these efforts without taxing property held as the homestead.

heading: ABOLISHING HOAs and PROPERTY TAXES ON HOMESTEADS
text: And with new HOA scams arising every single day throughout the state, Floridians are paying double their property taxes when unelected HOA boards “assess dues” for the exact same thing Floridians are paying the county for.

heading: ABOLISHING HOAs and PROPERTY TAXES ON HOMESTEADS

heading: ABOLISHING HOAs and PROPERTY TAXES ON HOMESTEADS

heading: Byron Donalds Gets Sued for Assault, but Fishback’s Racist Response is Worse. Why Voting NPA is the BEST Option for Governor of Florida
text: A bombshell lawsuit (or a dud) was filed against Florida gubernatorial candidate Byron Donalds by a woman named Kelly Mason over a confrontation that occurred in 2022. Mason alleges that she was cornered by Donalds before he threatened her, but the video shows Donalds losing his cool in, what most social media users describe as an argument, and a “set up”.

heading: Byron Donalds Gets Sued for Assault, but Fishback’s Racist Response is Worse. Why Voting NPA is the BEST Option for Governor of Florida
text: Sure, Donalds may have anger management issues, but the real controversy surrounds the response from the other republican candidate, James Fishback, who shares the same lawyer as Kelly Mason . Fishback took to X to release a racist statement on the nature of the lawsuit , before stating that Donalds “ chimped out ” in another X post.

heading: Byron Donalds Gets Sued for Assault, but Fishback’s Racist Response is Worse. Why Voting NPA is the BEST Option for Governor of Florida
text: Fishback described Donalds as a 6’5, 260 pound man (Donalds is 6’2) who cornered a “blonde woman”, echoing Jim Crow era pretextual sentiments used to portray Black men as a danger to White women. In addition to this, Fishback adopted the term “chimping out”, coined by prolific racist Chud the Builder , who is currently behind bars on hate crime charges after he shot a Black man he called a slur. Some Fishback supporters expressed that use of that term cost him their vote while others stated that it was worse than using the N-word.

heading: Byron Donalds Gets Sued for Assault, but Fishback’s Racist Response is Worse. Why Voting NPA is the BEST Option for Governor of Florida
text: Fishback doubled down on his use of the term “chimping out”, and formally issued a press release using the racist language.

heading: Byron Donalds Gets Sued for Assault, but Fishback’s Racist Response is Worse. Why Voting NPA is the BEST Option for Governor of Florida
text: The chaos between the republicans came to a head this week, but not before yet, another confrontation in Collier County where members of Fishback’s entourage had a physical altercation with elderly voters at a Donalds event. Fishback’s online supporters called the elderly people “Byron’s Boomer Enforcers”. While no one was arrested for assaulting any of the elderly attendees, Fishback was removed from the event.

heading: Byron Donalds Gets Sued for Assault, but Fishback’s Racist Response is Worse. Why Voting NPA is the BEST Option for Governor of Florida
text: The Republican Party and its candidates are in utter chaos right now, and are simply not an option in this Florida gubernatorial race. Voters have had it with racism, bad behavior and division. The next Governor of Florida must be an NPA with No Party Affiliation. That’s why Moe Dimanche is in this race, because sensible Republican voters would rather vote for a common-sense NPA than racist and divisive Republican candidates. This is also why donors to Republican candidates have pledged their money in an effort to stop Moe.
